pr_title: eth-w5500 fixes, command read-back / reset pin toggle
pr_body:
I had bus faults in kernel scheduler during w5500_command(dev, S0_CR_RECV)
changed from k_sleep, which will allow other threads to wakeup to k_busy_wait (when necessary)
pr_comments:
@marcel-cd - please fix any whitespace / coding style issues.

Fixes #29013
Fix your commit message as well: title are wrongs and it lacks of content inside.
